name: Research planning and roadmap
definition: Define, structure and maintain the research plan — phases, objectives, milestones, timeline — as a living, inspectable record throughout the project.
expected_capabilities: phase and milestone definition; objective tracking; roadmap overview; plan revision history
relationships: drives RM3; plan changes are RM5 decisions; framed by RM15
known_limitations: research plans are emergent and iterative; over-formalisation can misrepresent non-linear work (S08)

name: Research question management
definition: Explicit documentation and versioning of research questions and their evolution, with links to the methods, analyses and outputs that address them.
expected_capabilities: question registration; revision history; question-to-method/analysis/output links
relationships: anchors RM10 provenance chains; feeds RM1
known_limitations: questions are often implicit or reformulated post hoc

name: Task management
definition: Identification, assignment, prioritisation and status tracking of discrete research activities and their dependencies across the lifecycle.
expected_capabilities: task creation; status; assignment; priority; dependency links; board overview
relationships: derives from RM1; produces RM9 artifacts; coordinated via RM7
known_limitations: manual upkeep burden; not all research work decomposes into tasks

name: Documentation
definition: Systematic, version-controlled recording of methodology, protocols, project structure and technical context, created from project start rather than at dissemination.
expected_capabilities: structured documents; templates; versioned edits; early-stage metadata
relationships: substrate for RM5, RM10, RM11, RM12
known_limitations: documentation debt; requires discipline and familiarity with Markdown / version control

name: Decision traceability
definition: Recording of significant research decisions with rationale, alternatives, date, participants and links to affected artifacts, so the reasoning behind the project can be reconstructed.
expected_capabilities: decision records; rationale and alternatives; timestamp; participants; artifact links
relationships: consumes RM4; feeds RM10 and RM11
known_limitations: judgement about what counts as a decision; tacit decisions go unrecorded (S23)

name: Collaboration and contribution tracking
definition: Support for multiple contributors — review, feedback, contribution attribution, parallel work — with a durable record of who did what.
expected_capabilities: review workflow; comment and feedback; contribution history; parallel branches
relationships: uses RM8 branches; informs RM10 agent provenance; overlaps RM7
known_limitations: review norms vary by discipline; not all fields do code-style review

name: Communication
definition: Structured, traceable project communication (discussions, threaded decisions, agreements) linked to the research activities it concerns.
expected_capabilities: threaded discussion; linking of topics to tasks and artifacts; searchable archive
known_limitations: informal channels (email, chat) leak outside the system

name: Version control
definition: Identifiable versions, change history, diffing and restoration for all research artifact types — data, code, documentation, text — not only source code.
expected_capabilities: history; diff; restore; tags and snapshots; large-file handling
relationships: substrate for RM6, RM10, RM14; enables RM12
known_limitations: large binary and data files; learning curve for non-programmers (S04)

name: Research artifact management and integration
definition: Systematic organisation of research artifacts (datasets, code, protocols, results, figures, manuscripts) in one structured space, with continuity across the heterogeneous tools used to produce them.
expected_capabilities: defined repository structure; artifact classification; cross-tool references; single navigable workspace
relationships: organises outputs of RM3; feeds RM10 and RM14
known_limitations: some artifacts must live in external systems (large data, specialised tools); integration is by reference, not containment

name: Research provenance and artifact linkage
definition: Capture and retrieval of the relationships linking questions, methods, data, analyses, results and outputs, so the origin and evolution of any output can be traced end to end.
expected_capabilities: activity-to-artifact links; lineage retrieval; cross-stage linking; granular history
relationships: consumes RM2, RM4, RM5, RM8, RM9
known_limitations: coverage typically stops at data and computation; upstream links require deliberate practice (S23)

name: Transparency
definition: Project progress, artifacts and change history are inspectable and understandable by third parties without privileged access.
expected_capabilities: visible status; shared or public history; accessible documentation; readable activity log
relationships: emergent property of RM4, RM5, RM8, RM10
known_limitations: some material must stay embargoed (ethics, IP, pre-publication)

name: Reproducibility support
definition: Documentation and preservation of the information needed to re-execute or re-derive the work (environment, parameters, data versions, steps) — supporting, not guaranteeing, reproducibility.
expected_capabilities: environment capture; pinned data and code versions; runnable steps; hooks for automated checks
relationships: builds on RM4, RM8, RM10; partly realised via RM13
known_limitations: full reproducibility needs external tooling (containers, archives); not in scope to guarantee

name: Automation
definition: Automatable execution of repetitive project activities — validation, testing, documentation and artifact generation, release steps.
expected_capabilities: event-triggered workflows; validation and CI; scheduled checks; build and release automation
known_limitations: technical complexity; benefit concentrated in computational research

name: Research output management and identification
definition: Identifiable, citable research versions (releases) connected back to the tasks and decisions that produced them, with persistent identifiers and interoperable metadata for exchange with external systems.
expected_capabilities: versioned releases; persistent identifiers via external archive; machine-readable metadata; output-to-process links
relationships: consumes RM8, RM9, RM10; bridges to the GitHub-Zenodo-ORCID workflow
known_limitations: long-term preservation and DOIs require external infrastructure (Zenodo, repositories)

name: Governance and sustainability
definition: Organisational arrangements for the continuity of the research management setup beyond the project — ownership, maintenance, access policy, skills, archival exit.
expected_capabilities: access and permission policy; ownership and handover; contribution guidelines; archival exit plan
known_limitations: largely institutional, not platform-solvable; only partly in scope (PHASE1 s6.3)
